prefix.title: Prefix
prefix.description: Partial street or address prefix string.

max_results.title: Max Results
max_results.description: Maximum number of suggestions to return.

addresses.title: Addresses
addresses.description: List of raw address strings or dictionaries to cluster.

explain.title: Explain
explain.description: Include standardization explanation and field confidence.

companies.title: Companies
companies.description: List of raw company names to cluster.

contacts.title: Contacts
contacts.description: List of raw contact dictionaries to standardize.

records.title: Records
records.description: List of raw contact dictionaries to cluster.

organization.title: Organization
organization.description: Optional raw company or organization name.

person_name.title: Person Name
person_name.description: Optional raw contact person full name.

social.title: Social
social.description: Optional raw contact social URL or @handle.

ContactStandardizeRequest.title: ContactStandardizeRequest
ContactStandardizeRequest.description: Request payload for /v1/contact (joint multi-pillar entity cross-healing).

DedupOverrideRequest.title: DedupOverrideRequest
DedupOverrideRequest.description: Request payload for excluding or restoring a row from single-file deduplication clusters.

DedupRunRequest.title: DedupRunRequest
DedupRunRequest.description: Request payload for running single-file deduplication.

path.title: Path
path.description: Absolute or workspace-relative file path on local disk.

delimiter.title: Delimiter
delimiter.description: Optional delimiter override for text files.

LiveInspectRequest.title: LiveInspectRequest
LiveInspectRequest.description: Request payload for Live Inspector single-entity or pairwise comparison sandbox.

MatchDecisionRequest.title: MatchDecisionRequest
MatchDecisionRequest.description: Request payload for steward match pair approve/reject/reset override.

MatchRunRequest.title: MatchRunRequest
MatchRunRequest.description: Request payload for running a two-file cross-system match.

persons.title: Persons
persons.description: List of raw person names to cluster.

phones.title: Phones
phones.description: List of raw phone strings to cluster.

PresetSaveRequest.title: PresetSaveRequest
PresetSaveRequest.description: Request payload for saving a field mapping and options preset.

source_id.title: Source Id
source_id.description: Registered uploaded or local source identifier.

source_id.title: Source Id
source_id.description: Uploaded or local source_id of child member table.

RosterAttachPayload.title: RosterAttachPayload
RosterAttachPayload.description: Configuration for attaching a child member roster file to Left or Right records.

StandardizePreviewRequest.title: StandardizePreviewRequest
StandardizePreviewRequest.description: Request payload for dry-run file standardization preview.

StandardizeRunRequest.title: StandardizeRunRequest
StandardizeRunRequest.description: Request payload for running full file standardization.
